issues.description: GetLimit complects descriptor traversal, wildcard matching, and metric-key construction in one loop with duplicated builders
issues.detail: Two parallel key builders (detailedMetricFullKey, valueToMetricFullKey) with three near-identical branches (matchedViaWildcard, matchedUsingValue, default) collapse to one rule: append key, optionally with value. Extract a per-descriptor segment renderer driven by a single mode decision so the algorithm is self-evident and the descriptor owns its segment representation.

issues.description: Post-hoc RateLimit reconstruction-then-mutation violates the abstraction and is a workaround for wrong data flow
issues.detail: The override block calls NewRateLimit and then overwrites Stats/FullKey on the returned value, mutating a value derived from shared descriptor state. Compute the final key once during the walk and pass it to a single NewStats call at construction. The extra allocation and discarded intermediate stats indicate the data is fighting the algorithm.

issues.description: Enhanced-key branch reads rateLimit.FullKey before non-detailed paths have set it, and FullKey semantics are quietly extended
issues.detail: The comparison enhancedKey != rateLimit.FullKey is undefined when the detailed_metric branch did not run, since FullKey may be zero or stale from shared config state. The detailed_metric path now also mutates FullKey as a piggybacked behavior change. Establish FullKey-matches-Stats.Key as a single invariant at construction time.

issues.description: Two boolean knobs (detailed_metric, value_to_metric) with a prose precedence rule encode one decision: how to render the metric segment
issues.detail: These are not orthogonal flags; they are one render-mode choice (KeyOnly | KeyValue | Detailed) whose precedence is enforced by code ordering. Model it as a single metric_mode enum computed once per descriptor at load time. The current design will accrete more flags and more precedence rules as it grows.

issues.description: Positional struct literal for rateLimitDescriptor is fragile against new fields
issues.detail: &rateLimitDescriptor{map[...]{}, rateLimit, nil, descriptorConfig.ValueToMetric} relies on field order. The next field added will silently misalign every call site or force mechanical edits. Use named-field initialization so the struct's contract is explicit at construction.

issues.description: Tests cover happy-path rendered key strings but miss unmatched-descriptor and cross-level flag-interaction cases
issues.detail: Every new test pins a fully-rendered dotted string, so the per-level decision is not asserted as data. The nil-nextDescriptor fallback (which still appends entry.Key 'for determinism') and parent-vs-leaf flag interactions are not directly covered. Add tests for early-terminated walks and document the cross-level contract for which descriptor's flag controls which segment.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is useful but the implementation is complected: GetLimit runs two parallel key builders through the descriptor walk with three near-identical branches that collapse to one rule. The post-hoc RateLimit reconstruction-then-mutation is a workaround for the wrong data flow and weakens the abstraction's contract, and the enhanced-key comparison reads FullKey before non-detailed paths establish it. The two boolean knobs are really one render-mode decision. Decompose: compute a per-descriptor metric mode at load time, extract a pure segment renderer owned by the descriptor, build the key once, and construct RateLimit as a single value. Add tests for unmatched-descriptor and cross-level flag interactions, and switch to named-field struct literals.
